title: Autonavy admin recipe executor with snapshot-safe replays
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a safe, auditable "autonavy" executor for operator 'recipes' (sequences of admin actions) that can be run ad-hoc from the Console or scheduled/triggered by alerts. The executor must capture a compact snapshot of the system state required to validate and (optionally) replay the recipe, enforce idempotency, scrub secrets, and emit structured telemetry for post-run analysis. Goals: reduce manual toil for common incident remediation steps by 40% for Tier-1 oncall flows, enable controlled automation rollouts, and provide clear human-in-the-loop approvals for high-impact steps.
acceptance_criteria: Executor can ingest a recipe manifest (YAML) and run it against a target environment in dry-run mode without applying changes
Snapshot capture includes resource versions/etags and a minimal KV of dependent state sufficient to re-run critical steps
Runtime enforces idempotency for at least the first three control primitives (restart service, scale deployment, rotate secret) with deterministic outcomes
All executions are logged with structured events (start/step/success/failure/rollback) and persisted to the audit store with a run ID
Console can display ongoing run progress and allow operator to pause/abort/advance with a single click
A canary rollout mechanism exists to enable automated runs for a subset of non-production projects
End-to-end e2e tests covering dry-run, normal run, failure/rollback, and replay are present in CI
